about: Jindal Stainless Limited manufactures and sells stainless-steel flat products in India and internationally. The company offers ferro alloys, stainless steel slabs and blooms, hot rolled coils, plates and sheets, and cold rolled coils and sheets; specialty products, including razor-blade steel, coin blanks, and precision strips; and long products, such as decorative stainless-steel pipes, rebars, and wire rods.
